string-array.name: quotes_local
string-array.item: One step at a time, but take that step today.
Every big thing started with a small \"let me try\".
Smile: it\'s free and it suits you.
Today is a good day to do something you\'ll be proud of tomorrow.
Coffee helps, but enthusiasm does more.
You don\'t have to be perfect, you just have to begin.
Even the rough days end with a good night.
Breathe, laugh, start again.
You are stronger than you think and funnier than you believe.
The remote is yours: you choose how the day goes.
Slowly but surely, you get far.
After the rain the laundry dries: stay optimistic!
Do one hard thing today and the rest will feel lighter.
A good laugh beats a thousand alarm clocks.
If the road is closed, take another. Your GPS does it all the time.
Every day is a blank page: write something good.
Be kind: it costs little and pays a lot.
Even a turtle gets there if it keeps walking.
You have survived 100% of your difficult days so far.
Think positive: at least the Wi-Fi works.
The secret? Start before you feel ready.
A little courage, a little patience and a lot of pizza.
It is never too late to start over.
No excuses today: just good ideas and a good coffee.
Mistakes mean you are learning a lot.
Give yourself five calm minutes: you deserve them.
Your future self will thank you for what you do today.
Make peace with Monday: it is not going anywhere.
Life is good, especially with a couch and a nice film.
A big dream starts with a small alarm clock.
A messy try beats a perfect idea in a drawer.
Drink some water and be kind to yourself.
Every sunset promises a new sunrise.
Be the reason someone smiles today.
When the road goes uphill, you are getting somewhere high.
Success? A bit of talent, lots of persistence, very few excuses.
You may rest. You may not quit.
Little habits change big days.
Even the longest journey starts with a click.
You are exactly where you need to be to begin.
Find one nice thing in today. There always is.
You are not late: you are on your way.
